format: HDF5 (.h5 VIIRS SDR granules, one whole file per band plus one geolocation file)
notes: No model in the repo (examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/, model docstrings, model default sources) reads from JPSS; variables are the full JPSSLexicon VOCAB valid for product_type='M'.
JPSSLexicon gates variables by product type (jpss.py:_validate_variables): I=5, M=16, L2=14 keys; M chosen as the largest.
Source returns the granule nearest the requested time and appends _lat/_lon, so 18 variables are returned for 16 requested.

Rolling archive: the NOAA NODD bucket only held 2026-08-13 onward when listed on 2026-11-13 (about 92 days), so this time expires around 2027-02-08; update `time` to a recent date before running later.
